alternative.meaning: A state-table account: a seven-module generic sensor assembly opens into a labelled teaching loop and observation branch, separating Ada's power-state planning from the colleague's PCB work and from what an observation shows.

observation.text:
All concepts
The power-state assembly · concept sketch
Email

1 / State

Ada Mensah. Firmware for a physical device.

For embedded firmware roles. I wrote Mosslink’s firmware and scheduled its power states. My colleague designed the PCB and analogue front end. The assembly makes that division visible.

What can a power-state plan tell you—and what needs an observation?

Seven solid modules form a generic sensor assembly. This is explanatory geometry, not the actual PCB, enclosure or circuit.

See the middle · Evidence & contact

2 / Observation

Planning a state is not observing it.

Sleep, Measure, Transmit is a teaching sequence, with no claimed durations or current values. A current trace showed the radio awake after a failed transmission; no cause or resolution is confirmed.

Modules separate into a teaching loop and an observation branch. Their positions do not depict recovered firmware or timing.

3 / Evidence

Keep the projection beside the run.

The battery projection is two years, based on bench current readings and an assumed reporting cycle. The longest run was 72 hours. These support different claims; full qualification remains unfinished.

Estimate and Run remain distinct when the sensor assembly comes back together.

ADA MENSAH / LOCAL CONCEPT STUDY

From firmware
to observation.

Three scroll sketches. Each has an opening, a middle and an ending carried by one tangible object. Geometry is explanatory; it does not reconstruct Mosslink or depict test evidence.

01 / Bring-up checklist
The bring-up fixture ↗

Command, access and observation separate from the same solid fixture. Recommended: closest to the fixture Ada built and the work a hiring manager needs to understand.

02 / State table
The power-state assembly ↗

A generic sensor assembly separates planning from observation, using a labelled teaching loop.

03 / Timing diagram reading
The observation loom ↗

Probe connectors order the relationship between command, observation and an open question, without invented timings or traces.

Choose the story structure first. Typography, colour and final wording will have their own review.
